draft.title: Tired of headsets that press into your skull after an hour of calls or commutes?
draft.body: You know the feeling — you slip on a headset for your morning subway ride, a work meeting, or a study session, and within an hour, your ears ache and the headband feels like it’s digging into your scalp. Most headsets cut corners on comfort, forcing you to choose between clear audio and not ending the day with a headache. This wired over-ear headset is built differently. It features soft foam ear cushions and a padded plastic headband lining that distributes pressure evenly, so you can wear it for hours without discomfort. The adjustable mic boom lets you position it exactly where you need it for clear voice pickup, whether you’re taking work calls on the go, joining online classes, or gaming with friends. The plastic shell feels durable without feeling heavy, and it comes in silver and black to match your style. It works for every part of your day: block out subway rumble on your commute, stay focused during back-to-back lectures, move freely during at-home workouts without it slipping, and keep your voice crisp during late-night game sessions. No fussy pairing, no dead batteries mid-call — just plug in and go. Save this post for your next headset upgrade, or tag a friend who’s still using a flimsy pair that leaves their ears sore.

Crisp sound for subway rides, online classes and gaming marathons, no flimsy build. Tap the link in bio to grab yours before stock dips 🎧

draft.title: Wired Over-Ear Headset With Microphone, Adjustable Mic Boom, Foam Ear Pads, For Commute Office Online Class
bullets: Clear hands-free calls: adjustable mic boom with foam wind cover; positions close to mouth for consistent voice pickup during calls or online classes
All-day wear comfort: soft foam ear cushions; plastic headband with foam lining; distributes pressure evenly for long office or study sessions
Reliable wired connection: fixed cable exit; no pairing or battery drain delays; works with laptops, desktops, and mobile devices with 3.5mm jack
Lightweight over-ear build: plastic outer shell; stays secure during commutes, study marathons, or casual gaming sessions
Two finish options: silver and black; matches most desk setups and personal tech accessories
draft.description: Designed for daily use across work, study, and leisure, this wired over-ear headset delivers steady, no-fuss performance without the need for charging or wireless pairing. The adjustable microphone boom lets you position the mic exactly where you need it, while the foam wind cover reduces background breath noise for clearer voice transmission during video calls, virtual classes, or in-game voice chat. For long hours at the desk or full school days, comfort matters. The headset features plush foam ear cushions and a foam-lined plastic headband that sits gently on the head, reducing pressure buildup even during extended wear. The over-ear design helps muffle ambient room noise, so you can stay focused on meetings, lectures, or gameplay without cranking the volume. The wired design means you can plug in and use the headset right away, with no app setup, no firmware updates, and no dead batteries mid-session. The cable exits from a sturdy, fixed point on the ear cup for added durability, and the 3.5mm connector works with most laptops, desktop computers, tablets, and smartphones. Available in silver and black, the headset fits easily into different setups and personal styles. Whether you are commuting with your phone, taking online classes from home, working in a shared office, or gaming late at night, it offers a practical, comfortable audio solution built for regular use.
